identity.description: LiveAgent is cloud help desk software by Quality Unit with email, live chat, phone, social media, knowledge base and AI agents in one shared inbox.
identity.identity_notes: Sources describe LiveAgent, made by Quality Unit.

auth.oauth_flows: MCP server supports OAuth 2.1 sign-in with consent screen for clients such as claude.ai.
auth.scopes_notes: MCP access tokens are scoped to approved actions and checked against the account's department and role permissions.

access.production_restrictions: No free plan; after the 30-day trial a paid plan is needed. The MCP server is only on Business and Enterprise plans (and the trial).

api.limitations: API v1 docs are dated; newer v3 endpoints exist (e.g. api/v3/ticket/{ticket_id}/messages).

claims.quote: You can get this in case your athentification with API key failed because of problem with API key in application.
It uses an access token you generate in your own profile, or an OAuth 2.1 sign-in with a consent screen, so it always acts as one account you approved.
